page.tag: Kajik’s bookshop · the clockwork stall · Rockside
page.title: Page, the bookbinder
page.role: Bookbinder · elf · one of the Faery Fire Five
page.mood: Helped the party reach the Hollow Heart
page.intro: At the festival, Page gave Ethan a book about crafting trinkets.
page.about: Page had attended the Feylight Festival before and helped persuade the group to go. At Kajik’s Books, he promised to return in one year in exchange for a book. He later gave that book to Ethan, saying that curiosity should always be rewarded. At the cistern house, he kept a psychic link open while Legion approached the hive. After the courtyard escape, he helped the party reach the Hollow Heart and paid for their rooms. In session 26, he helped disguise Coy as a healer and told Ceridwen about his long connection to the Devereaux family and his promise to protect Simon.

ceridwen.tag: A story at the gate · a letter for the Copperfields
ceridwen.title: Ceridwen’s stories and songs
ceridwen.role: Singer · storyteller · one of the Faery Fire Five
ceridwen.intro: Ceridwen’s story persuaded Thom to admit the whole party to the festival.
ceridwen.about: Ceridwen paid the party’s way into the Feylight Festival with a story. At the clockwork stall, she persuaded the ogre to accept an item of equal value in place of Ethan’s hundred years of service, then wrote a letter explaining the situation to his parents. At the cistern house, she played the campfire song Legion knew from the road. She later helped Coy dispel three magical trap nodes. In session 26, she contacted Stross by Sending and cast Zone of Truth while the party questioned the masked newcomer; the newcomer resisted the spell, so the account remained unconfirmed.

coy.tag: A clockwork bird · transmutation · Shape Water
coy.title: Coy’s field record
coy.role: Druid · healer · one of the Faery Fire Five
coy.mood: Preparing to work as a healer in Rockside
coy.intro: Coy bought a clockwork bird at the festival and gave it to Ethan.
coy.about: Coy helped Ceridwen search for Ethan in Lobridge. At the festival, he bought the boy a clockwork bird and helped escort him back to his parents. At the cistern house, Coy detected transmutation magic resembling Legion’s magical presence and reminded Legion to remember themself during the meeting of swarms. He identified the toxin in a hive passage, helped Ceridwen dispel three trap nodes, and used Shape Water to wash the poison away. In session 26, he examined the masked newcomer’s injuries and planned to help injured people in Rockside while looking for information about Haven.

legion.tag: Rat-ions · clay tablets · the question of a name
legion.title: Legion and the other hive
legion.role: Swarm · one of the Faery Fire Five
legion.mood: Sent animal messengers to find Hive and Selim
legion.intro: Legion made peace with the festival-road weasel by offering a dried rat.
legion.about: Legion offered a dried rat to the angry weasel on the road to the Feylight Festival. In the cistern house, they let their robed shape collapse, dropping clay tablets and runes, and joined the frightened swarm. They shared memories of Simon. When the new being asked who it was, Legion answered with images of sunrise and sunset and later spoke with it about travel and names. Legion also trapped the intruders’ entrance with caltrops. In session 26, they sealed the inn’s door with clay at night, supplied goodberries, and sent animal messengers to look for Hive and Selim.

simon.tag: A silver ticket · a traded memory · a globe’s map
simon.title: Simon Devereaux in the record
simon.role: Devereaux · one of the Faery Fire Five
simon.mood: Remembered by Legion in the cistern
simon.place: The Shave precinct morgue · party’s last identification
simon.intro: Simon memorized the map on the broken clockwork globe and drew it afterward.
simon.about: Simon won a silver ticket at the festival’s hammer-and-bell booth. He paid Page’s messenger five silver and traded a memory to Alara for help finding Ethan. When Ethan tried to run from the clockwork stall, Simon caught him. Simon then studied the map on the broken brass globe, memorized it, and stopped with Ceridwen to draw it. Later in Latesa, the party identified a body in the Shave precinct morgue as Simon through its tattoos and a scar. Legion shared memories of him when trying to reach the frightened hive. This page records what the party witnessed and believed; it adds no offscreen account of his fate.

selim.tag: White and gold · citizenship for the hive
selim.title: Captain Selim Varek
selim.mood: Assigned to protect and assist the party
selim.place: The Whites courtyard · last published scene
selim.intro: Selim treated the theft of a sentient hive’s brood as a question of kidnapping.
selim.about: Stross brought Captain Selim Varek to the Bohun estate as a trusted ally assigned to protect and assist the party. The session recap describes his white-and-gold uniform and his belief in the goddess. After Legion explained that someone was stealing the hive’s larvae, Selim reasoned that the theft would be kidnapping if the hive were a citizen. In the courtyard fight, he attacked the militia spearman and later kicked the spear away from Page. Session 26 records Legion sending messengers to look for him; it does not establish a new location for him.

the-gunslinger.tag: The Whites courtyard · the Hollow Heart
the-gunslinger.title: The masked gunslinger
the-gunslinger.role: Masked newcomer · introduced herself as Sandra Vale
the-gunslinger.mood: Questioned by the party at the Hollow Heart
the-gunslinger.intro: At the inn, the newcomer introduced herself as Sandra Vale and said she was investigating Simon’s killers.
the-gunslinger.about: The party first encountered the gunslinger in the Whites courtyard: a small figure with two pistols, a wide-brimmed hat, a red-and-purple coat, and a clicking construct. She fired on the militia while Page held them with wind. In session 26, she introduced herself as Sandra Vale and claimed to work for the Devereaux family in pursuit of Simon’s killers. She resisted Ceridwen’s Zone of Truth, so the spell did not confirm her story. She said she needed her mask to survive and showed the party severe scarring. Coy examined the injury. Her stated name and allegiance are recorded claims, not an independent confirmation of her identity.
